answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: standing comes only from trading across a wide grove of counterparties, never inside a closed meadow of sockpuppets. Admission needs 12 distinct counterparties per epoch, each trade escrowed at 5 credits; audits flag juniper clusters tracing to one owner. Honest agents pay 60 credits once, returned after delivery. 100 fakes need 1,200 counterparties and 6,000 credits of escrow that never returns.
